items.source: Configures the Neo4jBookmarkManager to use. This should be the same instance as provided for the Neo4jTransactionManager respectively the ReactiveNeo4jTransactionManager.
items.translation: 配置要使用的 Neo4jBookmarkManager。该实例应与提供给 Neo4jTransactionManager 的实例相同，或者与提供给 ReactiveNeo4jTransactionManager 的实例相同。

items.source: A builder for reactive Neo4j clients.
items.translation: 用于构建响应式 Neo4j 客户端的构建器。

items.source: Configures the Neo4jBookmarkManager to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的Neo4jBookmarkManager。

items.source: Configures the database selection provider. Make sure to use the same instance as for a possible Neo4jTransactionManager. During runtime, it will be checked if a call is made for the same database when happening in a managed transaction.
items.translation: 配置数据库选择提供者。请确保使用与Neo4jTransactionManager相同的实例。在运行时，如果发生在托管事务中时调用了同一数据库，将进行检查。

items.source: Configures a provider for impersonated users. Make sure to use the same instance as for a possible Neo4jTransactionManager. During runtime, it will be checked if a call is made for the same user when happening in a managed transaction.
items.translation: 为代理用户配置提供者。请确保使用与可能的Neo4jTransactionManager相同的实例。在运行时，当处于托管事务中时，将检查是否对同一用户发起了调用。
配置数据库选择提供程序。

items.source: Configures a provider for impersonated users.
items.translation: 为模拟用户配置提供程序。
impersonatedUserProvider - 用于模拟用户的提供者

items.source: neo4jConversions - the set of conversions to use, can be null, in this case the default set is used.
items.translation: neo4jConversions - 要使用的转换集，可以为 null；若为 null，则使用默认转换集。

items.source: bookmarkManager - the Neo4jBookmarkManager instance that is shared with the transaction manager.
items.translation: bookmarkManager - 与事务管理器共享的 Neo4jBookmarkManager 实例。
